semanticCues.purpose: First locate the flower landmarks. Pollen/sperm magnification gives way to a larger nested ovary/ovule/embryo-sac/egg cutaway. Parent boundaries remain spatial containers, not transformations.

spokenAnchors: Pollination means transferring pollen
The pollen grain begins growing a pollen tube.
provides a route for sperm cells
A sperm cell then joins the egg cell.
Their fusion forms a zygote
semanticCues.purpose: Pollen moves to and remains at the stigma. Tube draws down the style and into a magnified ovule route. A separate sperm marker travels towards the egg. Fusion changes only the cell identity inside the retained embryo-sac and ovule boundaries.

spokenAnchors: After that fusion, the zygote
divides and develops into an embryo
The surrounding ovule develops into a seed.
The ovary usually develops into the fruit
semanticCues.purpose: Show one cell, a schematic dividing-cell cluster, and a contained embryo. The surrounding ovule envelope persists as the seed envelope and coat. Separate usually-qualified fruit view encloses seeds. Stored resources remain distinct from embryo.

spokenAnchors: A strawberry runner is a stem
A node is a point on the stem
At a suitable node, roots and a shoot can develop
without sperm and egg joining
A new rooted plant can become independent
semanticCues.purpose: Runner stem draws from parent to a node. Root strokes and a shoot grow at that node before independence can be described. The connecting runner remains present; no instant detachment or genetically-identical guarantee.

spokenAnchors: Self-pollination means pollen
Cross-pollination means pollen
When compatible pollen leads to sperm joining an egg
semanticCues.purpose: Replace same-plant route with different-plant route, then add the conditional sperm-egg fusion rule. Moving pollen indicates transfer, not completed fertilisation.

reuseDecisions.reason: Useful paired petals, anthers, stigma/style and cutaway motif expanded to the native board. Hardcoded anther/male and stigma/female substitutions, whole ovule-to-zygote, seed-varied and identical-clone claims are excluded. This component is not imported or modified.

Actual namespaced DioramaDefs and bounded stone plinth imported for a stable location reference. Plinth shadows were kept inside the 620-unit component extent by source calculation. No particle atoms or ambient motion compete with labels.
Inter Tight display family, Biology blue and existing ink/amber tokens. Plant green, coral, cream and brown distinguish botanical structures with explicit labels.
Native plant/leaf geometry informs the new large rooted runner silhouette. Disease, transport block, wilting and clone claims do not serve the selected task and are not imported.
Existing roots/shoots and coded flow separation considered. Plant nutrition, gas streams, pot, sun and day/night scene are outside this reproductive mechanism, so no component or artwork imported.

reuseDecisions.decision: reuse teaching approach, not calculation scene
reuseDecisions.reason: Editorial diorama and stable coded quantities provide a useful native construction vocabulary. Use deterministic stroke growth and staged semantic states. Generic painted laboratory and calculation columns are unrelated to this plant mechanism.

The native mechanism test keeps identity labels distinct from moving structures. Apply that principle to pollen, tube, sperm and egg. DNA replication and painted molar-mass atmosphere are not imported or exhibited as extra features.

scientificInvariants: Anther and stigma are flower parts, not replacements for sperm and egg.
Pollen grain and sperm cells are different structures.
Ovary contains ovules; ovule contains embryo sac; egg lies inside that sac.
Pollen at stigma establishes transfer only. Tube route and sperm delivery precede the separately cued fusion event.
Only sperm-egg fusion cell becomes the zygote. The whole ovule remains a surrounding structure.
Zygote develops into embryo; surrounding ovule develops into seed containing embryo. Coat and stored resources are not drawn as produced solely by zygote.
Ovary-to-fruit is separate and qualified usually.
The model follows embryo-forming fusion, not double fertilisation, endosperm production or a complete life cycle.
Runner reproduction requires a new rooted plant at a suitable node, not stem lengthening alone.
No universal clone identity, offspring survival, superiority or universal fertilisation requirement for every seed is asserted.
Self/cross pollen routes do not guarantee fusion, seed formation or a surviving plant.

motion.holds: Text stays fixed once revealed. No CSS animation, random state, bobbing text or decorative particle loop.
